correctness.rationale: Every all-size quantifier is supported: VC lower shatters all penultimate-level vertices; VC upper assigns disjoint parent-of-leaf blocks to any shattered coordinates, using comparability and identical-leaf-bit obstructions. Littlestone upper conditions on an arbitrary positive vertex query: independent sibling-subtree frontier factors have exact additive dimension, with a telescoping sum at most m-1; the general VC<=Ldim bound supplies equality. Recursive frontier counts imply the stated entropy slack. The standalone independent recurrence computation confirms 29 small profiles plus three taller examples. No finite experiment substitutes for the proof.

value.rationale: The class is a natural model of hierarchical cuts, complete prefix codes and disjoint hierarchical partitions. The theorem gives an all-height, all-positive-branching exact learning invariant and a nontrivial optimal online mistake strategy independent of final-level branching. It sharply separates the true adaptive complexity from the exponentially loose log-hypothesis bound, while proving equality to static VC dimension. Not a one-off finite enumeration, parameter renaming, or restatement of a known product recurrence.
